Mains syllabus (official)

PaperSyllabusMarks
I - Civil LawCode of Civil Procedure, Punjab Courts Act, Indian Contract Act, Sale of Goods Act, Partnership Act, Specific Relief Act, Transfer of Property Act 1882, East Punjab Urban Rent Restriction Act 1949, Indian Evidence Act 1872200
II - Civil LawHindu Law, Mohammedan Law and Customary Law, Law of Registration and Limitation200
III - Criminal LawIndian Penal Code, Criminal Procedure Code, Indian Evidence Act (now BNS, BNSS and BSA)200
IV - English LanguageEssay (1000-1100 words), precis, words and phrases (make sentences), comprehension, corrections200
V - Punjabi (Gurmukhi)Essay 100 + language and grammar 50, matric (PSEB) standard150
